name: Nightline repair route
request: The board feels crowded. Keep the campaign name and the real 27 repairs. Make the typography readable, recommend three different compositions, then give your top three critique changes.

sources.text: A mobile bicycle repair van visited three residential courtyards over two evenings, 10–11 August. The objective was to bring a repair service closer to residents who could not reach the workshop during daytime hours.

27 repairs were completed during the two evenings. Entries refer to repair jobs, not necessarily 27 unique customers. No historic comparison, satisfaction survey or longer-term cycling measurement was collected.
